subject: Spec: Emoji aria-hidden for decorative icons
body: ## Problem Decorative emoji in MCM UI are exposed to screen readers. '💡 HINT' reads as 'light bulb HINT'. '📊 See the Board' reads as 'bar chart See the Board'. These degrade screen reader experience. ## Rule Emoji that appear alongside text where the text alone is sufficient should have aria-hidden='true'. Emoji that ARE the content (no adjacent text) should have role='img' aria-label='[description]'. ## Specific Changes Needed ### Hint button: '💡 HINT' ```html ``` ### Nav links: '📊 See the Board', '🔄 Run It Back', etc. ```html 📊 See the Board 📊 See the Board ``` ### Grade celebration emoji in messages If grade emoji appear with descriptive text (e.g., '🏀 Grade 4: Elite Performance'), the emoji is decorative. Apply aria-hidden. If a grade emoji appears ALONE without text (uncommon -- check first), use role='img' aria-label='Grade 4'. ## What NOT to change - Any emoji in data content (hint text, feedback_correct, feedback_wrong) -- these are in the DOM dynamically from JSON, not worth wrapping - Emoji in coach messages inside the scorecard (dynamic text content) - The emoji characters themselves (never remove, only add aria-hidden) ## Acceptance Criteria 1. Hint button emoji wrapped: `💡` 2. CTA link emoji wrapped: '📊', '🔄' in nav links 3. Grade celebration message emoji in scorecard wrapped 4. No emoji removed -- only aria-hidden added 5. Screen reader reads 'HINT' not 'light bulb HINT' ## Scope - exam.html: hint button(s), CTA links, grade messages - index.html: any UI emoji (not content emoji) ## Priority: Normal (medium) This is a screen reader improvement, not a visual change. ## Related - da-18: Icon audit (finding: emoji not aria-hidden where decorative) - .design-system.md Section 16 (accessibility patterns)
